source: TAT-2 expansion content built from the shipped Skybox distant-building kit
notes: KF11's mission-preparation frame stands the thief on a slate ledge with the Kilcairn skyline behind her: a dark mid-ground roofline whose tops sit around screen y 0.37, the full moon clear above it at (0.76, 0.09), and open sky in the upper right. This file adds that far-city layer over the authored MissionLobby_Geo3 + MissionLobby_Periphery load.

This file is original TAT-2 layout data, not extracted content: it places shipped Skybox meshes/materials (/Game/Art/Environment/Skybox/...) in a camera-relative ring. The runtime never rewrites the authored sublevels.

Placement contract (T05): azimuth_deg is measured from the prep camera's horizontal forward (+ = left, matching Godot's +Y rotation); distance_m is the horizontal metres; base_y is the ABSOLUTE world Y of the mesh AABB bottom (not camera-relative); yaw_deg is the node's Y rotation; scale is uniform.

Composition band (W9-P1): the band is KF11's MID-GROUND roofline, not the pre-T05 standoff. The pre-W9 authoring kept the city at 310-500 m with base_y 0, which projects its tops to screen y 0.746-0.954 — that is the near roof's band in KF11, and at the authored camera those pieces were measured to contribute zero visible pixels (prep vs prep_nosky identical). The city now sits on the hill behind the lobby (absolute base_y 18-36) so its tops land in [0.28, 0.46], measured 0.300 / p50 0.380 / 0.440 by game/tests/test_t05_ui_contract.gd P14 against the spawned meshes. KF11's silhouette tops measure p50 sy 0.372.

base_y is high because the authored camera stands on a ledge BELOW the city's ground level: the far ground plane is never in frame (the near ledge and roofline occlude it), so the layout is authored as silhouettes on the hillside rather than as a ground plane.

Each piece must satisfy, on its projected mesh AABB: width <= 0.60 frame widths, top edge in screen y [0.28, 0.46], and horizontal overlap with the 0..1 frame. P14 enforces this against the real spawned meshes; the -16 deg..-2 deg azimuth range keeps the set right of the prep card stack, where KF11's skyline is visible.

Visibility proof (W9-P1, 1920x1080, TAT2_AO=on, authored grade): build/qa/w9/captures/p1_after_prep.png measures mean 37.1 / p50 19 / p95 125 / 18.8 % below 8, and the same frame with this group freed (prep_nosky, p1_after_nosky.png) measures 43.9 / 29 / 126 / 8.8 % — freeing the city brightens the mid-ground by 6.8 mean / 10 p50 points, so all eight pieces are in frame. Seven sit fully in the visible stage area (x >= 0.54, right of the card stack); far_row_west is the furthest row and is partly behind the cards by design.
layer is documentation only: mid = the roofline band KF11 shows behind the ledge, far = the horizon row and vertical accents behind it.
